rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the bed covering used as a duvet.

example.english: It was cold last night, so I added a duvet before I could sleep.
example.traditional: 尋晚凍，我加咗張被先瞓得着。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 dung3 ngo5 gaa1 zo2 zoeng1 bei6 sin1 fan3 dak1 zoek6

rows.note: Use this when specifying that the duvet is filled with down.

example.english: This duvet is very light but warm enough.
example.traditional: 呢張羽絨被好輕，但係夠暖。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 jyu5 jung4 bei6 hou2 hing1 daan6 hai6 gau3 nyun5
